LyricsTier.description: How precisely the lyrics are timed: `word` (every word or syllable has a time), `line` (every line has a start time) or `unsynced` (plain text, no times).

LyricWord.description: A word or syllable with its timing. Times are track positions. `text` includes its trailing space, if any, so joining the texts of a line gives the line.

LyricLine.description: One line of lyrics. In `unsynced` lyrics, `startMs` and `endMs` are null and `words` and `background` are empty.

startMs.description: When the line starts, or null in unsynced lyrics.

endMs.description: When the line ends, or null when the source does not say (then it lasts until the next line starts).

text.description: The main vocal line. Can be empty for an instrumental break.

words.description: Word or syllable timings of `text`. Empty unless the tier is `word`.

background.description: Background vocals sung over this line, timed like `words`. Often empty.

Lyrics.description: Lyrics for one track in Sonolith's normalized model, whatever the source format was.

provider.description: A short, stable id of the lyrics source, for example `lrclib`. The set grows over time; treat unknown values as opaque.

providerName.description: The source's display name, for example `LRCLIB`.

attribution.description: Credit text the source asks to show, for example `Lyrics provided by …`, or null. Show it when not null.

lines.description: The lines in order. Sorted by `startMs` when synced.

LyricsResult.description: The answer to a lyrics lookup.

lyrics.description: The lyrics when `status` is `found`, otherwise null.

lineIndex.description: The index into `Lyrics.lines` of the line being sung, or null before the first line and during breaks.

text.description: That line's text, or null when `lineIndex` is null.

positionMs.description: The playback position when the event was sent.

wordIndex.description: The index into the line's `words`, or into its `background` when `background` is true.
